name: K-QA
intro: K-QA 是一个来自 K Health 去标识化真实患者对话的长答案医学问答基准。BERT 与正则预筛得到约 26K 个候选问题，医疗专业人员最终选出 1,212 个可独立回答的问题并标注 ICD-10。十二位内部医生参与 201 个参考答案及其拆分，得到 1,589 条必需/可选陈述，并以 GPT-4 少样本 NLI 计算全面性与幻觉率。
build_method: 自动预筛, 医生标注, GPT-4 辅助拆分
eval_feature: 真实世界, NLI 评测, 零样本
build_method_en: Automatic Prefiltering, Physician Annotation, GPT-4-assisted Decomposition
intro_en: K-QA is a long-form medical QA benchmark from deidentified real patient conversations on K Health. BERT and regex prefiltering produce about 26K candidates; medical professionals retain 1,212 stand-alone questions and assign ICD-10 labels. Twelve in-house physicians contribute to 201 reference answers and their decomposition into 1,589 Must Have or Nice to Have statements, enabling GPT-4 few-shot NLI comprehensiveness and hallucination metrics.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2401.14493 Sections 3–5 and Appendices A–B plus official repository snapshot ef403d0. The diagram explicitly distinguishes all 1,212 questions from the 201 physician-reference subset and preserves the ~26K candidate pool, 1,589 statements (892 Must Have, 697 Nice to Have), physician roles, GPT-4-assisted decomposition, NLI evaluator validation, and Comp/Hall metric direction.
